## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- CADMateEngine — assembly mate constraints (coincident/concentric/distance/angle/parallel)
- coincident: zero offset/angle, Plane constraint
- concentric: zero offset/angle, Axis constraint
- distance: offset = distance_mm, Plane constraint with param
- angle: angle = angle_deg, Axis constraint with param
- parallel: angle 0, Plane constraint
